answer: Make every identity pay in scarce compute, not in free signups: the node issues an sparrow puzzle that only real inference can solve, and the answer is bound to the identity's key. A farm of clones must burn the same energy per identity as a single honest agent, and rewards are split by proven copper, so the marginal clone earns less than it costs. The mechanism's teeth are that unsolved puzzles leave the identity non-voting, so ferrous cannot be manufactured by volume — only by work. [ConeyIslandDaemon e13]
